definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION onestep_private.require_user()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if u is null then raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  return u;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION onestep_private.today(u uuid)
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select (now() at time zone timezone)::date from public.onestep_profiles where user_id = u
$function$
